facts.value: Leaving Certificate Students can apply to the University of Limerick through the Central Applications Office (CAO).
facts.programme_association: Bachelor/Master of Engineering in Digital Mechatronic Engineering

facts.value: Qualified candidates to all undergraduate degree courses are placed in order of merit based on a points system.
facts.programme_association: Bachelor/Master of Engineering in Digital Mechatronic Engineering

facts.value: Applicants must be at least 16 years of age on the 15 January of the year of entry.
facts.programme_association: Bachelor/Master of Engineering in Digital Mechatronic Engineering

facts.value: If a candidate below that age wishes to enter the University of Limerick, a special application must be made to the University via the Admissions Appeals Process.
facts.programme_association: Bachelor/Master of Engineering in Digital Mechatronic Engineering

facts.value: Applicants are required to hold the established Leaving Certificate (or an approved equivalent) with a minimum of six subjects which must include two H5 (Higher Level) grades, AND four O6 (Ordinary Level) grades OR four H7 (Higher Level) grades.
facts.programme_association: Bachelor/Master of Engineering in Digital Mechatronic Engineering

facts.value: Applicants are required to hold the established Leaving Certificate (or an approved equivalent) with a minimum of five subjects which must include five O6 (Ordinary Level) grades, OR five H7 (Higher Level) grades.
facts.programme_association: Bachelor/Master of Engineering in Digital Mechatronic Engineering
